commands.command: python reproduce_scripts/reproduce_slab.py train  (runs, per method: python train.py --dataset slab --model_name slab --batch_size 128 --lr 0.1 --epochs 100 --out_classes 2 --train_domains 0.0 0.10 --test_domains 1.0 --slab_data_dim 2 --slab_noise 0.1 --n_runs 10 + method flags)
python reproduce_scripts/reproduce_slab.py evaluate  (python test.py --test_metric per_domain_acc --acc_data_case train ... --test_domains 1.0 --slab_noise 0.1 --n_runs 10)

experiment: Slab synthetic dataset (7-slab, 2-D, linear+slab features), 2-layer MLP (SlabClf, hidden 100); source domains with linear-feature corruption prob 0.0 and 0.1, target domain with corruption 1.0 (slab noise 0.1); methods ERM, DANN, MMD, CORAL, RandMatch, CDANN, C-MMD, C-CORAL, PerfMatch
notes: Method flags (reproduce_slab.py:26-51): erm=erm_match penalty_ws 0 match_case 0; rand=erm_match match_case 0 penalty_ws 1.0; perf=erm_match match_case 1.0 penalty_ws 1.0; mmd/coral/c-mmd/c-coral=method mmd with gaussian/conditional flags, penalty_ws 0.1; dann: penalty_ws 0.01 grad_penalty 0.1 d_steps_per_g_step 4 conditional 0; c-dann: penalty_ws 0.01 grad_penalty 1.0 d_steps 2 conditional 1.

Domain names are the spur_corr fractions of corrupted linear feature (0.0, 0.10, 1.0); slab noise 0.1 is fixed for all domains. The script data_gen_syn.py generates all combos of slab_noise [0.0,0.1] x spur_corr [0.0,0.1,0.2,0.9,1.0] x train/val/test x seeds 0-9, 10000 samples each; the loader keeps only the first slab_num_samples (default 1000) per file (utils/slab_data.py:89). So train=1000/domain, val=int(1000/4)=250/domain, test=1000 for the target.
argparse prefix matching lets --dataset resolve to --dataset_name; the dataset is therefore 'slab'.

Optimizer in BaseAlgo.get_opt (used by ERM/Rand/Perf/MMD family): SGD momentum 0.9 nesterov True, lr 0.1 (CLI), weight_decay default 5e-4 (not overridden). A StepLR scheduler is created (step_size=25) but scheduler.step() is never called anywhere, so lr is effectively constant. The lr schedule block at the end of erm_match.py only applies to lenet/domain_bed_mnist.

DANN ignores self.opt: it uses its own two plain SGD optimizers (lr 0.01 hard-coded, no momentum, weight_decay 5e-4); --lr 0.1 is unused for DANN/C-DANN. DANN alternates discriminator-only and generator-only updates by EPOCH (epoch % (1+d_steps) < d_steps), not by batch. Generator loss = CE + lambda * (-disc_loss) with disc_loss including grad_penalty*||grad||^2.

ERM/Rand/Perf (erm_match): the CE loss is computed on batches drawn from the match structure (get_match_function_batch), each element holding one point per source domain, so a step has 2*128 points, not on the loader's x_e. Batches stop at len(data_matched). Matching penalty is l2 between features at the logit level (match_layer default logit_match; slab model fc_layer=1, so logits) averaged over pairs, with weight penalty_ws*(epoch+1)/(epochs+1) (penalty_s=-1, match_flag=0 default) i.e. linear ramp. Random-match vs perfect-match differ only by match_case. ERM has penalty_ws=0 but still goes through the matched-batch path.

MMD/CORAL (method mmd): per-step loss CE + penalty_ws*MMD on featurizer output (feat_net, 100-d), constant weight; gaussian=1 multi-bandwidth Gaussian kernel (MMD), gaussian=0 mean+covariance (CORAL); conditional=1 computes it per class. Loader batch size 128 drawn from the pooled shuffled domains.

Reported number: train.py prints for each run's best and aggregates over 10 seeds (seed run*10): 'Final Test Accuracy (Source Validation)' = target(test-domain, 1.0) accuracy at the epoch with max source val accuracy (np.argmax, first max), and 'Final Test Accuracy (Target Validation)' = max over epochs of target test accuracy (oracle). Both print np.mean and np.std (population std, not SE). The 'evaluate' case (test.py per_domain_acc, acc_data_case train) loads the saved best-val checkpoint and reports per-source-domain accuracy on the train split (the training data, per domain) averaged over seeds with np.std/sqrt(n) (standard error). The repo does not state which one is the paper's target column; the tuning script uses the 'Source Validation' line.

Hyperparameter tuning (slab-tune.py): grid penalty_ws in [0.1,1,10] (mmd family, rand, perf), [0.01..100] x grad_penalty x d_steps for DANN, run with 3 seeds; selection reads data[-4] of the log, i.e. 'Final Test Accuracy (Source Validation)', which despite its comment is the accuracy on the TARGET test domain 1.0 (at the source-val-selected epoch). So hyperparameters are tuned on target-domain test data. ERM tuning grid is only penalty 0.0.
Source val accuracy is checked each epoch for checkpoint saving (strict > best), so the saved model = best source-val epoch; test accuracy is also computed every epoch (and used for the oracle line).
MatchDG / IRM / CSD / mask_linear branches in slab-run.py are not part of this table (Table 1 uses reproduce_slab.py).
